'''Morjanssik City Hospital''' was a hospital that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents traveled to Morjanssik to investigate a sabotage in the city. When the rebels crash-landed in the city, a group of [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] medical workers rescued the rebels and took them to Morjanssik City Hospital three [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] later. At the hospital the rebels received first-class medical attention.<ref name="Death" />
